title: Government Spending on 2025 World Aquatics Championships Versus Benefits and Sponsorships Generated
what_it_is: Government Spending on 2025 World Aquatics Championships Versus Benefits and Sponsorships Generated

sections.label: Community activities and tourism receipts
sections.summary: Up to 350,000 Singaporeans can join community activities, and about 40,000 international visitors are expected, generating some $60 million in tourism receipts.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: Singaporeans can look forward to a variety of related community activities organised at the sidelines of the main event.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: We expect up to 350,000 Singaporeans will have the opportunity to participate in these activities.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: Some of these community activities will be commencing soon in the lead-up to the main event, such as the SG60 Swim Challenge that we will launch in April this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: We expect to welcome about 40,000 international visitors to Singapore for the World Aquatics and World Aquatics Masters Championships 2025.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: Based on this, the estimated incremental tourism receipts generated by these international visitors is estimated to be some $60 million.

sections.label: Temporary facility use beyond WCH
sections.summary: The facility will host the World Aquatics Masters Championships and is being studied for extension for other meets, athlete training and public use.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: Besides using the facility for the WCH, it will also be used for the World Aquatics Masters Championships that would be held from 26 July to 22 August this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: We are also studying the possible extension of the temporary facility to be used as a training and competition venue for other local and regional meets, as well as for athlete training and for public use, beyond the hosting of the WCH.

sections.label: Temporary venue extension and Kallang Alive
sections.summary: The temporary venue's use for competitions, training and public use beyond WCH is being looked into, and it sits on the Kallang Alive masterplan footprint.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: With regard to the temporary venue, as I had mentioned earlier, we are already looking into the possible extension of the use of that facility for competitions, training and public use beyond WCH.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: The temporary venue actually sits on the footprint of the Kallang Alive masterplan.

sections.label: Venue extension and event cost
sections.summary: The venue's use beyond WCH will be considered, and organisers' common stance is not to be more excessive than past editions of the same event.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: Definitely, we will be considering whether we can extend the use of the venue beyond its WCH utility.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: On his second question about cost, I think a common stance amongst organisers of such international, global sporting events, us included, will be not to be more excessive than past editions of the same event.
